holds.detail: Exact eligible ordinary edible profile, dimensions and reference value <=10gp for14lb remain unprovided. Recipe90 Vegetables is2gp/0.1lb, hence280gp. No cheaper same-name alias. Separate0.5lb source-qualified positive does not discharge the original14lb obligation.

The original80lb blank still needs actual composition/value<=10gp, lawful whole-volume placement and an actual permitted cut method/time/tool/physical result. Conditional longsword/cut arithmetic and partition tests supply no completed creation/cutting transaction.

Actual trained/acquired/prepared actors, mundane items, samples, safe food preparation, supports, evidence authenticity/coverage/access/comprehension, lawful ordinary eating and real repair stock/work are explicit synthetic premises, not grants or authenticated campaign facts.
Only Woven/Haze gain the new600-second family recovery. Disrupt Memory and actual independent Erase masks keep their complete rules. No broader memory-restoration effect is invented.

Exact arithmetic authorizes no cutting tool, Action, damage exemption, manufacturing recipe, station, donor, transmutation or free repair. Complete other source needed for the requested physical operation.

Recipe90 proves unitprice/mass and ordinary food substrate, not universal raw-food safety, shelf-life, magical meal or fullSupply. The positive sample's already-safe grade and compatible consumption are explicit fixtures. Unknown compositions/sales/recipes remain actual world requirements.

Authoring records and independent arithmetic are not a memory/event engine, source qualification service, scheduler, RNG interface, inventory, canonical object splitting/repair, save-load or private presentation implementation.

Human gameplay, numerical balance/economy, cosmology,75-domain, whole-game and release remain separate. Permanent production and evidence restoration are consequential proposed design choices, not balance findings.
